ranges.description: Jopil is a man of average height with an ordinary, unremarkable face. He has hair long enough to flutter and toss about when something passes close, and narrow black eyes like a viper's. Tags: male, average height, ordinary face, long loose hair, black eyes, viper-like gaze

Jopil is a man of average height who looks like an old man. His hair has turned white and still falls long enough to flutter, and his skin is shriveled and shrunken. His eyes are still black like a viper's. Tags: male, old man, average height, white hair, long hair, shriveled skin, black eyes, viper-like gaze
